status.description: OPEN while any member is still open; COMPLETED when the last open member completed; ABANDONED when every member left without completing.

cpt.description: The batch's priority band — every member shares this CPT instant.

formed_at.description: The formation instant; the walk's `walk_seconds` on WorkBatchCompleted is measured from it.

stop_seq.description: The 1-based visit order of this stop (hint rank order, ADR 0063 D6).

compartment.description: The cart position holding this task's items; v1 assigns it by stop order.

state.description: The member's state inside the walk. DETACHED means the task's lease expired and it returned to the pool through the existing sweep.

schema.description: RFC 7807 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs) error response, used for every error this API returns. See https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807.

type.description: A URI identifying the error category. Does not need to resolve to a real page — it is an identifier, unique per distinct error category in this service.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code, per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced the error. Omitted for a validation error on a bare collection-create endpoint (`POST /tasks`, `POST /stations`, `POST /rebin/arrivals`) whose path has no segment identifying a specific resource.

schema.title: Problem

500.description: An unexpected server-side failure (e.g. a repository or event-publisher error).
